scope: Read-only verification of openly accessible GIS vectors; no AI tracing, geocoding or bridge placement.

network_policy.note: Overpass/OSM API probes and environment network draft are managed by parent, not this task.

usable_layers_limits: Natural Earth scale 1:10 million is a generalized small-scale geographic dataset. It does not support city-level precise route or bridge validation.
Clipping intersects real source geometries and does not trace any screenshot. Clipped ocean and land retain real source boundaries, including multipart geometry.
No source river or lake intersects the requested local bbox. No river or lake has been invented or sketched; these layers must remain empty.
15 road source geometries intersect bbox; every retained road lacks name, route ref, routeraw and label. They may be shown as generalized background roads, but no retained road is confirmed to be S1.
S1 mainline, exact study start/end and surveyed 59 detection-unit locations have not been verified by this task.
